content_zh:
而这个少女大怒之下，另外一只玉腕轻轻一抖，原本雪白如玉的皓腕上竟然多了一个非常精致美丽的小弩。
“嗖……”一支火红的小箭闪电一般射来。
如此近的距离，阳顶天躲无可躲。阳顶天本能一掌击出，要劈飞射来的小箭，顿时十几道玄气迸射而出。
顿时，那小箭猛地射入阳顶天的掌心，却直接化开变成火热恐怖的能量，猛地穿透阳顶天的掌心，刺入他的胸膛。
与此同时，阳顶天的右手变得如同火一般通红，因为惯性无意中直接劈在少女胸口上。
那少女顿时一呆，然后惊呼出声，愤怒无比，猛地一掌劈下。
与此同时，西门炎火红的鞭子猛地抽在阳顶天的头顶上。
阳顶天仿佛被雷劈了一般，三股非常凶猛的火热能量霸道地钻入体内，仿佛瞬间要将整个身体撕开。
顿时，阳顶天的身体猛地火红，全身的鲜血开始沸腾。
“啊……”一声狂吼，阳顶天死死抓住少女的小手，双目尽赤，充满愤怒望着少女，嘴巴一张，一口火烫的鲜血猛地喷出几米，瞬间倒地，人事不省！
那个少女只觉得脸上一阵滚烫，绝美如玉的小脸直接被阳顶天的鲜血喷中。其实以她的修为是完全可以躲开的，但是她虽然刁蛮傲气，却从来没有杀过人，此时急怒之下竟然杀了一个人，片刻间呆住了。
片刻后，用力一甩阳顶天的手，小嘴颤抖道：“竟敢，竟敢碰我……，死有余辜！”
然后，她依旧要拿走阳顶天胸前的火焰挂饰，但是用力一甩，竟然没有挣脱阳顶天的手掌。她本来可以用玄力直接将阳顶天的“尸体”甩飞出去几十米，不过那样阳顶天只怕浑身的骨头都要碎裂了，但是犹豫后她没有用玄力，而是凭借自己本身的力气拼命要挣脱。
西门炎脸色一寒，直接拔出利刃上前，要将阳顶天的手掌剁掉。
“放肆！还不住手？”忽然，远处传来一阵充满威严的怒斥，是一个中年男子的声音，明明很远，却仿佛在耳边响起，震撼整个心肺，让西门炎一动不敢动。
“城主来了！”
所有人齐齐下马，跪在雪地上。
与此同时，几串马蹄声由远而近，一股逼人的气息迎面扑来！
*******
阳顶天仿佛是在太上老君炉鼎中的孙悟空一般，时时刻刻被凶猛的火焰煅烧，就算在昏迷中也感觉到无比的痛苦。

这和洗髓伐脉的痛苦还不一样，这种痛苦完全是暴力型的，要将阳顶天身体完全撕碎的，要直接将他致死的。所以虽然处于昏迷中，但阳顶天依旧痛苦得生不如死。
一直到一双柔软的手掌按在他的心口，然后一股清凉的气息压制下浑身涌动的火热。紧接着，嘴里仿佛被灌下冰冷的液体，顿时整个身体仿佛大旱几年后伤痕累累的大地接受大雨甘霖的滋润。
就算在昏迷中，无数的思绪在脑子内涌动，让他整个心神在昏迷中都不得安宁。
“我的火焰挂饰，我不卖，把挂饰还我……”
阳顶天一声怒斥，然后猛地坐起，清醒了过来。
此时，他已经不是在雪地上，而是在一个华贵温暖的房间内，躺在一张芳香柔软的大床上，床头站着一个温文尔雅的俊秀中年人，他穿着素色的长袍，目光温润，面如冠玉，浑身上下，就只有束发的玉冠才看得出他的富贵。
“你终于醒过来了。”中年男子温和道。
阳顶天一摸胸前，发现火焰挂饰已经不见了，顿时用毛利语急怒喊话，但是他又不知道毛利语还我火焰挂饰应该怎么说，所以只喊出了还我两个字。
“怎么？我女儿抢了你什么东西吗？”中年男子问道，用的是这个世界的通用语言。
阳顶天心中一惊，那个童颜少女是眼前这人的女儿，她抢走了自己的火焰挂饰作为父亲的不可能不知道。那个少女强买火焰挂饰还可以说是见猎心喜，眼前这个中年男子却装着不知道自己女儿抢走火焰挂饰就心怀叵测了。
“难道他认出了火焰挂饰？不可能啊？师父说这个火焰挂饰只有师娘和师妹才认识的。”阳顶天心中暗道，却依旧装着听不懂对方的言语，用毛利语大声喊东西还我。
“小兄弟，你不用装成毛利野人了，毛利蛮语我很精通的，你说得很不地道。”中年男子温润笑道，尽管是揭穿了阳顶天，却依旧给人一种如沐春风的感觉。

content_en:
When the girl was furious, her other jade wrist flicked slightly, and a very delicate and beautiful small crossbow appeared on her originally white jade wrist.
"Whoosh..." A small fiery red arrow shot out like lightning.
At such a close distance, Yang Dingtian had no way to hide. Yang Dingtian instinctively struck out with a palm, trying to knock off the incoming arrow, and suddenly more than a dozen lines of profound energy burst out.
Suddenly, the small arrow suddenly shot into Yang Dingtian's palm, but it directly turned into fiery and terrifying energy, suddenly penetrated Yang Dingtian's palm, and pierced into his chest.
At the same time, Yang Dingtian's right hand became as red as fire as it accidentally hit the girl's chest directly due to inertia.
The girl was stunned for a moment, and then she screamed, extremely angry, and struck down with her palm suddenly.
At the same time, Ximen Yan's fiery red whip whipped Yang Dingtian's head fiercely.
Yang Dingtian seemed to have been struck by lightning. Three extremely ferocious fiery energy penetrated into his body domineeringly, as if his entire body was about to be torn apart in an instant.
Suddenly, Yang Dingtian's body suddenly turned red, and the blood all over his body began to boil.
"Ah..." With a roar, Yang Dingtian grabbed the girl's little hand tightly, his eyes were red and he looked at the girl with anger, he opened his mouth, and a mouthful of hot blood suddenly spurted out for several meters, and he fell to the ground instantly, unconscious!
The girl felt her face burning hot, and her beautiful little face was directly sprayed with Yang Dingtian's blood. In fact, with her cultivation, she could completely avoid it, but although she was unruly and arrogant, she had never killed anyone. At this time, she actually killed a person in a rage, and she was stunned for a moment.
After a moment, he swung Yang Dingtian's hand hard, and said with a trembling mouth: "How dare you, how dare you touch me... You deserve to die!"
Then, she still wanted to take away the flame pendant on Yang Dingtian's chest, but she couldn't break free from Yang Dingtian's hand after flicking it hard. She could have used her mysterious power to directly throw Yang Dingtian's "corpse" dozens of meters away, but Yang Dingtian would have been afraid that all the bones in his body would be broken. However, after hesitating, she did not use her mysterious power, but relied on her own strength to desperately break free.
Ximen Yan's face turned cold, and he drew out the sharp blade and stepped forward to chop off Yang Dingtian's palm.
"Presumptuous! Why don't you stop?" Suddenly, a majestic and angry voice came from the distance. It was the voice of a middle-aged man. It was obviously very far away, but it seemed to be ringing in his ears, shaking his whole heart and lungs, making Ximen Yan dare not move.
"The city lord is here!"
Everyone dismounted and knelt on the snow.
At the same time, several strings of horse hoofbeats came closer from far away, and a compelling breath rushed towards me!
*******
Yang Dingtian seemed to be Sun Wukong in the Taishang Laojun's furnace, being burned by the fierce flames all the time, and he felt incomparable pain even in a coma.
This is different from the pain of cleansing the marrow and cutting the pulse. This kind of pain is completely violent. It will completely tear Yang Dingtian's body into pieces and kill him directly. So even though he was in a coma, Yang Dingtian was still in so much pain that life was worse than death.
Until a pair of soft palms pressed against his heart, and then a cool breath suppressed the heat surging throughout his body. Immediately afterwards, it was as if cold liquid was poured into his mouth, and his whole body suddenly felt like the scarred earth after a drought for several years was being nourished by heavy rain and sweet rain.
Even in a coma, countless thoughts surged through his mind, making his whole mind restless while in a coma.
"I won't sell my flame pendant. Please return the pendant to me..."
Yang Dingtian scolded angrily, then sat up suddenly and woke up.
At this time, he was no longer on the snow, but in a luxurious and warm room, lying on a fragrant and soft big bed. Standing at the head of the bed was a gentle and handsome middle-aged man. He was wearing a plain robe, with warm eyes and a face like a crown of jade. Only the jade crown that bound his hair could tell how wealthy he was.
"You finally woke up." The middle-aged manHe said gently.
Yang Dingtian touched his chest and found that the flame pendant was gone. He immediately shouted angrily in Maori, but he didn't know how to say return the flame pendant to me in Maori, so he only shouted the word "Give me back."
"What? Did my daughter steal something from you?" the middle-aged man asked, using the universal language of this world.
Yang Dingtian was shocked. The childlike girl was the daughter of the person in front of him. She had snatched his flame pendant, and it was impossible for her father not to know. The girl who forced her to buy the flame pendant could be said to be happy to see her, but the middle-aged man in front of her pretended not to know that his daughter had taken the flame pendant and had ulterior motives.
"Did he recognize the flame pendant? Impossible? Master said that this flame pendant is only recognized by the junior wife and junior sister." Yang Dingtian thought to himself, but still pretended not to understand the other party's language and shouted loudly in Maori to return the things to me.
"Little brother, you don't have to pretend to be a Maori savage. I am very proficient in the Maori savage language, but you speak it very unauthentically." The middle-aged man smiled warmly. Even though Yang Dingtian was exposed, he still gave people a feeling of spring breeze.
